$comment: Provenance sidecar (T2.1, GOV-REAL-DATA-001 rule 5). One entry per routed surface id that scripts/surface-guard extracts (every route and in-page tab): {endpoint, table, writer} with a REAL writer (user-action / importer / sync; never a seed, migration or fixture), or {register} naming an OPEN gap-register row of this app that explains why there is no live source yet, or {static} for a surface that renders no domain data. A surface with no entry is UNRESOLVED. Checked by `surface-guard provenance` (strict: the release preflight) and `provenance --report` (the test suite). Each entry was derived from the code path cited in `evidence`.

docs-tab:spotlight.endpoint: platform GoTrue GET /auth/v1/user, then PostgREST GET /rest/v1/user_product_licenses (the entitlement gate; the manual pages ship in the build)
docs-tab:spotlight.writer: user-action: licence activation in Periodical (tsai-periodical src/app/licensing/actions.ts:53 inserts the row)

route:/.endpoint: POST /api/beta-requests → platform PostgREST POST /rest/v1/lead_submissions (the beta sign-up form; the page reads no other domain data)
route:/.writer: user-action: the beta sign-up form (src/components/landing/BetaSignupForm.tsx:33) posting to /api/beta-requests

route:/api/beta-requests.writer: user-action: the beta sign-up form (BetaSignupForm) posting to this route

route:/api/billing/stripe/checkout.endpoint: GET /api/billing/stripe/checkout (public.plans + public.subscriptions) and POST /api/billing/stripe/checkout (Stripe Checkout Session)
route:/api/billing/stripe/checkout.writer: sync: Stripe webhook delivery (POST /api/billing/stripe/webhook) upserts caller subscription status and active_plan on checkout.session.completed and customer.subscription.updated

route:/api/billing/stripe/portal.endpoint: POST /api/billing/stripe/portal (reads supabase:public.stripe_customers with fallback to public.subscriptions.stripe_customer_id and creates a Stripe Billing Portal session)
route:/api/billing/stripe/portal.writer: sync: Stripe webhook delivery (POST /api/billing/stripe/webhook) upserts caller stripe_customers binding and subscriptions status on checkout.session.completed and customer.subscription.updated

route:/api/billing/stripe/webhook.writer: sync: Stripe webhook delivery (POST /api/billing/stripe/webhook) verifies stripe-signature and upserts stripe_customers, subscriptions, licenses, and user_product_licenses
